Frequently Asked Questions

Frequently Asked Questions

Some questions about VAME are asked frequently. We’ve answered the most frequent of those frequent questions below.

What services do your virtual assistants (VAs) offer?*

How is the rate for each VA determined?*
Edit Content

Each VA’s rate depends on their experience, skill set, and the services provided. We ensure our VAs receive fair compensation (their “happy rate”) to encourage high-quality, consistent support for our clients.

What if I have a problem with my VA?
Edit Content

Your satisfaction is our priority. If any issues arise, please let us know, and we’ll work to resolve them. If necessary, we can discuss reassigning a different VA who may be a better fit.

What time zone do your VAs work in?
Edit Content
Our VAs are primarily based in the Philippines, South Africa, and Ukraine, allowing for flexible scheduling. You don’t need to worry about time zones; we ensure they can adjust their hours to align with your preferred working times.
Where are your VAs based?

Do I pay the agency or the VA directly?
Edit Content
Click on the Edit Content button to edit/add the content.
How do I communicate with my VA?
Edit Content

You can communicate with your VA through preferred methods like email, Zoom, Slack, WhatsApp, or any other platform your team uses. We aim to make communication as seamless as possible to integrate your VA into your team’s workflow. Additionally, we will create a WhatsApp group chat to facilitate ongoing communication, and our team will be there to monitor the VA’s progress and provide support as needed.

What if I need a replacement VA?
Edit Content

If for any reason you need a replacement VA, we will work quickly to find a new match based on your requirements. We’re committed to ensuring continuity and minimal disruption for your business.

Are there any setup fees?
Edit Content

No, we do not charge any setup fees. Our onboarding process is included as part of our service, ensuring you get a smooth start with your VA without any additional costs. Everything is included in the VA’s hourly rate, so you only pay for the hours or services provided by your VA.
